purpose: Teach: 證/噺/英和/云わ/ノベル/広東/にたいする/事物

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字の医證、つまり證書の保管を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren — we're going to have the medical team handle the storage of old medical records.
lines.style: Even, professional tone. No rush. Straightforward delivery, like she's moving through a checklist with you. Clear and measured, but not cold.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様への説明の噺、つまり話法を医療チームで揃えます
lines.en: Ren — we're standardizing how the medical team explains things to patients, to keep our messaging consistent.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Slight emphasis on 'standardizing' — this matters for patient care. Still warm beneath the clarity. Not condescending.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医学英和辞典を医療チームで日常的に活用します
lines.en: Ren — the medical team will be using a medical English-Japanese dictionary as part of our daily practice.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact. Light emphasis on 'daily' — this is routine, not emergency. Unhurried. A doctor sharing protocol, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の云わ、つまり「云った内容」を医療チームで記録します
lines.en: Ren — we're going to document what patients actually tell us, and the medical team will keep those records.
lines.style: Careful, precise. Slight weight on 'what patients actually tell us' — this accuracy is important. Not rushed. Honest and grounded.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療系のノベル、つまり医療小説を医療チームで参考にします
lines.en: Ren — the medical team will be consulting medical literature as a reference point for our cases.
lines.style: Measured, almost reflective. No hurry. The kind of statement a careful doctor makes about learning from broader experience. Steady eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、広東省での感染症対応事例を医療チームで学びます
lines.en: Ren — we're studying past pandemic response cases, including those from Guangdong, to inform how we work as a team.
lines.style: Direct, grounded in experience. No dramatics. The voice of someone who has seen how preparation matters. Clear and committed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、終末期にたいするケアを医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Ren — the medical team is going to provide end-of-life care with careful attention and respect.
lines.style: Quieter, deeper gravity. Slower pace. This is sacred ground in her voice. Compassionate but not soft. The seriousness underneath.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療事物、つまり医療機器の整理を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren — we're organizing medical equipment and supplies, and the medical team will maintain that system.
lines.style: Back to professional rhythm, slightly quicker than before. Practical, closing-statement tone. Not rushed, but like we're finishing up. Warm close.
